search.selected_instruction: Select a valid route code from the available options based on the customer's input.

stop_reason: The exact selected artifact loaded and served in a fresh OS BEAM, but one of forty ordered predictions differed from the retained selected-stage result, so the byte-identical lifecycle acceptance failed.
diagnosis: The saved artifact, exact served-model identity, selected instruction rendering, call counts, and parse contract all matched. The retained evidence does not include request bytes or token logits, so it cannot distinguish backend numerical/state dependence from an unobserved request difference.
claim_boundary: This one task/model execution proves a genuine source-correct COPRO instruction mutation, trainset selection, task-specific held-out lift in the parent process, durable artifact application, and exact fused-artifact serving after restart. It does not prove byte-identical generation across MLX server restarts, general COPRO effectiveness, multi-seed effectiveness, whole-optimizer parity, production reliability, or BEAM superiority.
